input_policy: Exact existing source_detail image bytes; same model, Mac native/sync/deepstack; one fresh worker per frame, no retries or post-response prompt changes.
reference_policy: Two independent prior-exposed AI spatial references frozen before calls. Preserve both; disagreement or unresolvable occlusion stays unconfirmed. Existing state labels are diagnostic context only, never force geometry to fit.
evaluation_policy: Strict JSON schema and pixel bounds; bbox IoU>=0.5 plus marker center containment; visible wheels matched one-to-one maximizing within-expert-tolerance count, then matched pair count, then minimizing total error; boundary anchor-to-predicted-polyline segment distance within expert tolerance, evaluated only within predicted y coverage (no extrapolation). Preserve each expert separately. Nulls and absent reference geometry are unconfirmed, not correct or incorrect.
interpretation: New question and 768-token budget differ from previous 40-token state question. Observable spatial outputs do not reveal the old internal causal process. No official S2, entry override, production change, or generalization score.
stop: Exactly two model calls. Null/invalid/truncated outputs retained, never retried.
reference_alignment: Both experts annotated painted-stripe centerlines, so prompt explicitly requests centerline before any model calls. Tolerance includes stripe width/visual uncertainty; this is not precision contact timing. A front wheel f31 is not confirmed by B. Both cannot reconstruct f39 boundary. Numerical tolerance is a predeclared diagnostic choice, not calibrated confidence.
